policy: Safe staged seal: new M4 starts after party clear and original north panels closed; one-time legacy ingress until northern actors cross, no teleport
limitations: Manual visual/on-device performance acceptance remains pending.
3.5-second animation can be followed by a safety rally/door-closure interlock; its timer is not reset or extended.
Approved old-save recovery can temporarily open the north portal; it reseals permanently after all northern actors cross.
Existing disabled duplicate ship-hull history can give328 global records after explicit in-memory M1 restoration; accepted/current collision data identical, canonical/cold geometry327.
Source eligibility is not per-pixel shadow occlusion; static surface pools do not dynamically light moving actors.
Headless timings are observations, not FPS-equivalence or regression certification.
External runtime CDNs/Playwright/browser provisioning affect reproducibility; earlier transient bootstrap/input/checkpoint fixture failures and interrupted outputs are preserved.
stop: No staging, commit, merge, push or Milestone4.3.
